---
title: "2026 Florida Republican Primary for Governor"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(sf)
library(tigris)
library(plotly)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

# List all county precinct files inside the zip archive
files <- unzip("2026-pri-outputofficial.zip", list = TRUE)$Name

# Read and combine all county files
election_data <- map(
  files,
  \(f) read_tsv(
    unz("2026-pri-outputofficial.zip", f),
    col_names = FALSE,
    col_types = cols(.default = "c"),
    quote = ""
  )
) |>
  list_rbind()

# Summarize votes for candidates in the Republican primary for Governor
gov_rep <- election_data |>
  filter(X12 == "Governor", X16 == "REP") |>
  mutate(votes = as.numeric(X19)) |>
  summarize(total_votes = sum(votes, na.rm = TRUE), .by = X15) |>
  rename(candidate = X15)
```

```{r}
bar_plot <- gov_rep |>
  mutate(
    vote_share = total_votes / sum(total_votes),
    candidate = fct_reorder(candidate, total_votes),
    hover_text = paste0(
      "Candidate: ", candidate, "<br>",
      "Total Votes: ", label_comma()(total_votes), "<br>",
      "Vote Share: ", label_percent(accuracy = 0.1)(vote_share)
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = total_votes, y = candidate, text = hover_text)) +
  geom_col(fill = "firebrick") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "2026 Florida Republican Primary for Governor",
    subtitle = "Official precinct-level vote totals across all 67 counties",
    x = "Total Votes",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: Florida Division of Elections"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(bar_plot, tooltip = "text")
```

```{r}
# Find the candidate with the most votes in each county
county_winners <- election_data |>
  filter(X12 == "Governor", X16 == "REP") |>
  mutate(
    county = if_else(X2 == "Desoto", "DeSoto", X2),
    votes = as.numeric(X19)
  ) |>
  summarize(county_votes = sum(votes, na.rm = TRUE), .by = c(county, X15)) |>
  slice_max(county_votes, n = 1, by = county, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  rename(winner = X15)

# Load Florida county boundaries and join election winners
fl_counties <- counties(state = "FL", cb = TRUE, progress_bar = FALSE) |>
  left_join(county_winners, by = c("NAME" = "county"))

# Plot county map colored by winning candidate
ggplot(fl_counties, aes(fill = winner)) +
  geom_sf(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = "Winning Candidate") +
  labs(
    title = "2026 Florida Republican Primary for Governor by County",
    subtitle = "Candidate winning the most votes in each of Florida's 67 counties",
    caption = "Source: Florida Division of Elections & U.S. Census Bureau (tigris)"
  ) +
  theme_void()
```
